mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_people vp WHERE vp.user_id = #{userId}) AS totalVolunteerParticipations, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dp.give_price), 0) FROM donation_price dp WHERE dp.user_id = #{userId}) AS totalDonationAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM donation_price dp WHERE dp.user_id = #{userId}) AS totalDonationCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fp.give_price), 0) FROM funding_price fp WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND fp.status='PAID') AS totalFundingAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM funding_price fp WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND fp.status='PAID') AS totalFundingCount, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_people vp WHERE vp.user_id = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM donation_price dp WHERE dp.user_id = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM funding_price fp WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND fp.status='PAID') ) AS totalParticipations

SELECT dp.donation_price_id AS donationPriceId, dp.donation_id AS donationId, d.title AS title, dp.give_price AS amount, dp.created_at AS createdAt, 'PAID' AS status, -- 표시용 상수 NULL AS receiptUrl -- 컬럼 없음 FROM donation_price dp JOIN donation d ON d.donation_id = dp.donation_id WHERE dp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY dp.created_at DESC
